expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry/construction fidelity: the camera-facing apartment base now has a physical plinth toe, stair-tower returns, recessed isolation joints and grade shoulders rather than a building volume meeting the ground as an infinitely sharp line.

Weathering/context causality: foundation, hardscape/grass shoulders and worn-path erosion edges carry rain/splash/UV/foot-traffic metadata tied to physical interfaces rather than arbitrary dirt overlays.
Texture/microdetail and realism: ParkPath/plaza grass edges and WornPathB receive deterministic irregular ribbon geometry so 4K crops are not forced to show a perfectly rectangular texture boundary.

Lighting/shadows: contact depth is now produced by physical projection/recess geometry that can cast/receive real shadows in frontal and grazing light; no Visual Fidelity points are awarded until this is observed in Unity renders.
